method: NAIVE. Written straight from the deposited text using only the writing-l4-rules skill. No pipeline, no coverage table, no probe record, no independent test pass, no human gate. One pass, no review.
edition_encoded: Mental Capacity Act 2008 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/.

checks.command: l4 run mca-cases-capacity-care.l4 ; l4 run mca-cases-lpa-deputies.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: SCOPED to capacity, care, lasting powers of attorney and deputies' limits. mca-capacity-care.l4: ss 3 to 5 (principles and the test), s 4(5) (age 21), s 6 (best interests), ss 7 and 8 (protected acts and restraint), ss 26 and 28 (excluded decisions), s 42 (ill-treatment). mca-lpa-deputies.l4: ss 11 and 12 (making an LPA, donees, joint appointments), s 13 (what a donee may not do, the permanence certificate), s 14 (gifts), s 15 (revocation and termination), s 25 (restrictions on deputies). Not encoded: ss 9 and 10, Part 3A, the rest of Part 4 (rectification, protection, court powers), Part 5 except s 25, s 27, s 29, Parts 7 and 8, and Part 9 except s 42. The Code of Practice and regulations were not retrieved.
